headline: Tarantriss Tarantriss Web
title: Tarantriss | Tarantriss Web Mount With Web Grapple | Palworld Guide
video_script: Want to swing like a spider? Ride Tarantriss. Its partner skill, Tarantriss Web, makes it a mount with a double jump, and you can shoot spider web to grapple and move at high speed. At base it works Handiwork and Gathering at level three. It is a Dark Pal that does both jobs well. Do you grapple with Tarantriss? Comment below!
description: Tarantriss in Palworld 1.0: a mount with double jump and a web grapple, plus Handiwork and Gathering at level three.
